نتراجم (form VI)
# نَتَرَاجَمُ (natarājamu) /na.ta.raː.d͡ʒa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاجَمَ (tarājama)
# نَتَرَاجَمَ (natarājama) /na.ta.raː.d͡ʒa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَاجَمَ (tarājama)
# نَتَرَاجَمْ (natarājam) /na.ta.raː.d͡ʒam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَاجَمَ (tarājama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
